design_parameters.enrich_notes: Treatment volume sizing references ERP Applicant's Handbook Volume I (sections 8.3 and 9.0); no WQv depth in inches in Vol II excerpts. Retention, underdrain, exfiltration trench, and swale share 72-hour treatment-volume recovery under average AMC; optional safety factor example uses 36-hour drawdown. System-wide quantity recovery for detention/retention storage is 14 days (3.2.7); wet detention draws down volume above permanent pool within 14 days. Exfiltration trench invert must be at least 2 ft above seasonal high groundwater (7.8). Swale geometry: top width-to-depth ≥ 6:1 or side slopes ≥ 3:1 (H:V).
